github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use Conventional Commits: type(scope): description. Types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert. Scope is optional and is the feature area, not the package name — tasks, notes, projects, tags, glasses, server, landing-page, contracts. Description is imperative mood, lowercase, no trailing period, max 72 characters. Breaking changes get a ! after the scope and a BREAKING CHANGE footer. Example: feat(tasks): add due-date picker to the task detail screen

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: The PR title must itself be a Conventional Commit (type(scope): description) — PRs are squash-merged, so the title becomes the commit on main and feeds release-please's changelog. Use feat for user-visible capabilities (minor bump), fix for user-visible bug fixes (patch bump), and docs/refactor/test/chore/ci for everything else. Write the body as prose explaining what changed and why; do not restate the diff file by file.
